spec.title: 4-lane MAC array, 8-bit
spec.text: A 4-lane multiply-accumulate unit. Each cycle it multiplies four pairs of unsigned 8-bit inputs and adds the four products to a running sum. After 16 cycles it raises done and holds the 22-bit result until reset. Smallest area matters most.

# SAMPLE FILE for UI development. Not a real golden model.
def golden_mac4(a_lanes, b_lanes, cycles=16):
    """Reference result: sum of lane products over 16 cycles."""
    acc = 0
    for _ in range(cycles):
        acc += sum(a * b for a, b in zip(a_lanes, b_lanes))
    return acc & 0x3FFFFF  # 22-bit result

# SAMPLE FILE for UI development. Not a real testbench.
import cocotb
from golden_model import golden_mac4

@cocotb.test()
async def acc_16_cycles_max(dut):
    expected = golden_mac4([255] * 4, [255] * 4)
    # drive 16 cycles of max inputs, then compare dut.acc with expected
    assert expected == 0x3F8040
